title: Auto Loans: Amount of a Bank-Error Late Charge Waiver
content:
For a late charge on an Auto Loans account that is withdrawn as PCB's error, this rule fixes the sum waived and its destination.

## Rule

The sum waived is the late charge in full, to the cent. No waiver is made where a fee waiver naming that late charge already exists on the loan's activity, or where PCB error has not been established for the debit behind it. Of the sum waived, any part the borrower had already paid toward the late charge out of a payment goes to reduce principal as of the day of the waiver, and the rest of it comes off fees due.

## Decision table

| PCB error established | Waiver already naming the late charge | Sum waived |
|---|---|---|
| yes | no | the whole late charge |
| yes | yes | none |
| no | no | none |
| no | yes | none |

## Illustrations (invented charges)

- An unpaid late charge of 18.50 that qualifies: 18.50 is waived and fees due fall by 18.50.
- A late charge of 18.50 that qualifies but was taken out of a later payment: 18.50 is waived and goes to principal on the waiver date.
- A qualifying late charge that already carries a waiver: no second waiver is made.
